prompts.name: 萤光秘境背景
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a NEW premium theme background plate for a 2D anime fantasy aquarium game, named 萤光秘境 / Firefly Grove. Landscape 16:10 composition, approximately 1600x1000. Entire scene is UNDERWATER inside a mysterious submerged forest spring. Make the dominant colors rich emerald, moss green and deep jade, with soft mint light and a few warm golden bioluminescent accents. This must feel like a lush forest grotto, not a blue tropical ocean, beach, coral bay, moonlit palace or ruins. Two enormous softly curved submerged tree roots and dark mossy root banks frame the far left and far right margins; sparse delicate lavender bell blossoms and luminous small fern fronds sit near these edge roots. A canopy-like sweep of roots occupies only the upper corners, never crossing the central window. Background depth is a soft misty green forest-pool gradient, no opaque wall or dominant central monument. Keep the central x=.20..80, y=.15..70 open and lower contrast so colorful fish read clearly. The bottom 25% is an open, gently level pale-jade moss-and-smooth-riverstone ground carpet suitable for separately placed cream/gold fantasy buildings; keep it quiet and uncluttered, without steep ledges, giant central boulders or thick grass. A faint green filtered light shaft from upper left, restrained underwater caustics, very sparse golden luminous specks mainly near the edges. Beautiful hand-painted Japanese anime game background, delicate illustrative outlines on edge objects, atmospheric painted depth, polished pastel fantasy finish. NO purchased buildings, houses, clock towers, windmills, boats, furniture, separate shop props, animals, fish, people, text, UI, border, tank glass or base. No blue open sea, turquoise beach, sandy shoreline, visible sky or above-water scene. Opaque environment background only. The framing overlay and all fish/buildings will be separate assets.

prompts.name: 藤叶纹缸框与浅金底座
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a premium 2D aquarium skin FRAME OVERLAY with an integrated base, named 萤光秘境缸. Make ONE empty ornamental aquarium frame, shown perfectly front-on in orthographic 2D view, symmetric overall, landscape outer proportion approximately 16:11. The CENTRAL APERTURE is a clean large rounded rectangle with an exact 16:10 width-to-height proportion and MUST BE TRULY TRANSPARENT. Both the entire aperture and everything outside the physical frame are transparent RGBA. There is NO glass pane, NO fill, NO reflections across the opening and NO scene inside it. Only the frame rails and its integral bottom plinth are drawn. Thin warm ivory and pale brushed-gold rails surround the opening; muted sage-green leaf-vine engravings wrap the four outer corners and side rails. Small elegant curling vine motifs with a few pale mint gems at the upper corners, restrained pearl-like accents. Keep all ornaments mostly outside the inner opening so fish and buildings remain visible. Below the window is a low broad shallow-gold and ivory stepped plinth with a fine continuous ivy-leaf frieze, gently curved outer corners, small integrated feet. The base is compact, approximately the bottom 10-12% of the entire frame, with no text plaque. Delicate blue-gray illustrated outlines, softly cel-shaded pastel Japanese anime fantasy game-asset finish, matching cream/gold marine fantasy buildings; polished, readable, cozy, not metallic photorealism and not plastic 3D. Keep straight horizontal and vertical INNER rails and a single connected closed border, no perspective angle or visible interior depth. The large transparent opening should occupy about 88% of total width. All architectural parts complete and uncut, a little transparent margin outside the object. NO background, water, landscape, forest, fish, animals, buildings, coral, bubbles, text, numbers, currency, UI, logos, watermark, cast shadow or detached sparkles. DO NOT draw a black or white rectangle inside the opening. Deliver only the physical ivory/gold vine frame and plinth as an actual transparent PNG overlay.
prompts.cleanup_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this transparent ivory-and-gold vine aquarium frame overlay. Keep its exact frame, integrated shallow plinth, feet, leaf engravings, two mint gems, pearl accents, proportions and large empty rounded-rectangular aperture. Remove the unwanted neon yellow/red outlines, tiny loose colored pixels and white matte residue around BOTH the outer silhouette and the inner edge of the window. Clean all detached debris inside the aperture and outside the frame into fully transparent pixels. Preserve the real warm gold painted trim and natural sage leaves; only remove the stray neon fringe and cutout artifacts. Use a neat delicate blue-gray contour on the actual material edges. The whole central aperture and outer background must remain truly transparent RGBA, no glass, no black/white fill, no reflections across the aperture. Do not add scenery, objects, shadows or text and do not redesign the frame. Keep the entire frame and feet uncut.
